captions.caption: A tan military vehicle moves across a dirt area.
The military vehicle starts to enter a shallow, muddy stream.
The vehicle drives further into the water, kicking up mud.
The vehicle accelerates through the stream, creating a splash.
Muddy water splashes high as the vehicle maneuvers through the stream.
The vehicle continues driving through the water, creating large waves.
The military vehicle moves deeper into the muddy water.
The vehicle is seen driving away from the camera through the stream.
The camera angle shifts to a front view of the vehicle.
The military vehicle approaches through the muddy path.
The vehicle speeds up as it enters a deeper section of water.
A massive splash of muddy water erupts as the vehicle drives through.
The front of the vehicle is partially obscured by the large splash.
The vehicle continues to push through the heavy splashing water.
The military vehicle emerges from the splash, moving towards the camera.
Muddy water drips from the vehicle as it continues forward.
The vehicle passes by the camera, splashing water to the side.
The side of the tan military vehicle is visible as it passes.
The vehicle drives past the camera lens into the distance.
The rear of the vehicle is shown as it drives away on dirt.
The vehicle moves further away into the hilly landscape.
The camera view changes to a wide shot of the stream.
The military vehicle appears in the distance, driving into the water.
The vehicle splashes into the stream from the left side.
The vehicle drives across the stream, creating a steady splash.
The military vehicle continues its path through the muddy water.
A large splash is created as the vehicle hits a deeper spot.
The vehicle moves towards the camera through the splashing water.
The vehicle is very close to the camera, creating a large wake.
The vehicle passes a person in military uniform standing on the bank.
Side view of the vehicle driving through the shallow stream.
The vehicle continues to move through the water past the observer.
The rear of the vehicle is visible as it moves away in the stream.
The vehicle continues driving away through the water and mud.
The scene cuts to the interior of the military vehicle.
The driver is seen steering the vehicle as it moves off-road.
The vehicle accelerates, and the engine noise increases.
The driver maintains control as the vehicle bounces on rough terrain.
The vehicle enters water, and the windshield wipers are activated.
Muddy water splashes onto the windshield as the vehicle drives through.
The wipers clear the muddy water from the windshield.
The vehicle continues through the water, with the driver focused.
The scene cuts to a slightly different interior angle of the driver.
The vehicle is moving through a brushy, off-road area.
The vehicle enters another section of water, causing a splash.
Muddy water covers the windshield as the vehicle pushes forward.
The windshield wipers work to clear the heavy splash of water.
The vehicle continues driving through the deep, muddy water.
Large splashes of water are visible through the windshield.
The driver navigates the vehicle through the turbulent water.
The vehicle continues its progress through the muddy stream.
The water level remains high as the vehicle drives through.
The driver steers the vehicle through the watery terrain.
The vehicle begins to emerge from the deeper part of the water.
Water continues to splash onto the windshield as the vehicle moves.
The wipers keep the windshield clear of the muddy water.
The vehicle is driving through a shallower, grassy area.
The driver maneuvers the vehicle over the uneven ground.
The vehicle continues its off-road path through the brush.
The driver remains focused as the vehicle moves forward.
